name: @inneranimalmedia/agentsam-cms
purpose: Portable executable SAM CMS machine with typed page/component tools, revision recovery, explicit publication, and the canonical cms-runtime SQLite storage schema.
use_when: Authoring or changing CMS drafts using validated, revision-safe operations
Installing CMS capabilities inside a standalone Ecommerce or desktop application
Resolving CMS definitions, preview, revision history and explicit publication
avoid_when: The consuming CMS repository or IAM permissions are not installed
Claiming Ecommerce deployment readiness from the SDK's local tests
Trying to use CMS mutation tools as an unrestricted Bash or D1 executor
